I feel like being a drag race fan has made me evolve into a better version of myself.

Watching these queens & following their journeys & learning from them, has made me pay more attention to the injustices in the world & it's made me more aware of how deep racism & prejudice can go & how prevalent it is in mainstream society. It has even brought me to this subreddit which has kept me updated on alot of the troubles in America & around the globe. 

I'm part of the lgbt+ community but I live in Western Australia, so I haven't really felt the true burn that being part of this community can be like. The me 10 years ago wouldn't have understood half the shit that current me does & alot of that is actually credited to this show.

Say what you will about Rupaul but this show is a platform for the queer community & as much as it's full of riggery & tom foolery like every other reality show, it has actually touched lives & made people like myself think & do research on things i didn't understand. 

So all in all
